title: Kanda 12: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 12.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 12.

verses.original: माता भूमिः पुत्रो अहं पृथिव्याः । पर्जन्यः पिता स उ नः पिपर्तु ॥
verses.transliteration: mātā bhūmiḥ putro ahaṁ pṛthivyāḥ | parjanyaḥ pitā sa u naḥ pipartu ||
verses.translation: Earth is my Mother, I am the child of Earth! The rain-cloud is my father, may he nourish us with bounty!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The immortal declaration of the Bhumi Sukta (Hymn to Earth): sacred kinship between humanity and the living planet.

layers.author: whitney
layers.content: सायण भाष्य: Earth is my Mother, I am the child of Earth! The rain-cloud is my father, may he nourish us with bounty!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: अथर्ववेद काण्ड 12: The immortal declaration of the Bhumi Sukta (Hymn to Earth): sacred kinship between humanity and the living planet.
